item.title: Who Is Alice Huang, the Woman in the Middle of Nvidia’s Spy Scandal?
item.description: Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence determined is a Chinese asset, emerged from the high-flying world of Shanghai finance to work with tech titans and obtain essential A.I. chips.
item.dc:creator: Paul Mozur, Ana Swanson, Tripp Mickle and Michael Forsythe
item.media:description: Jensen Huang and Alice Huang have been photographed together on several occasions. In this photo, posted to Weibo, they are at a Shanghai restaurant, Pujiang Huaiyan.

item.title: Despite Denial, Trump Was Told on Trip to China About Spying on Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
item.description: Before Jensen Huang boarded Air Force One en route to Beijing, the president was reminded of intelligence showing that he was in a relationship with a woman believed to be a Chinese spy.
item.dc:creator: Maggie Haberman, Jonathan Swan, Julian E. Barnes, Ana Swanson and Tripp Mickle
item.category: Ministry of State Security of the People's Republic of China
item.media:credit: Kenny Holston/The New York Times
item.media:description: Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s chief executive, during President Trump’s state visit to Beijing in May. He was not included initially, but joined at the last minute at Mr. Trump’s invitation.

item.title: Nvidia Hires Wachtell Lipton to Investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s Affair With Chinese Executive
item.description: Wachtell partner Joon H. Kim, a former acting U.S. attorney, is leading the inquiry into the chip maker’s chief executive.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Hirsch and Kalley Huang
item.media:credit: David Dee Delgado/Getty Images
item.media:description: Joon H. Kim, a partner with Wachtell Lipton, who is leading the inquiry into the Nvidia co-founder’s affair, was once acting U.S. attorney for the Southern District of New York.

item.title: America’s Measles Problem Has Reached Endemic Level
item.description: A panel of scientific experts will convene on Tuesday to evaluate the United States’ measles elimination status. But genetic data already shows the virus is once again endemic.
item.dc:creator: Apoorva Mandavilli

item.media:description: Genetic analyses traced at least three measles chains of transmission to Texas last year.
